question: What are Qnami's current main strengths? Give short bullet points
answer:
Here are Qnami’s current main strengths, summarized in concise bullet points:

• **Pioneering quantum sensing technology**  
  Qnami is recognized as a global leader in quantum sensing, particularly in scanning NV (nitrogen-vacancy) magnetometry, and is the first company to commercialize a quantum microscope (ProteusQ) ([qnami.ch](https://qnami.ch/?utm_source=openai)).

• **High-precision nanoscale imaging**  
  Their ProteusQ system enables simultaneous mapping of topography and magnetic fields at the nanoscale with exceptional spatial resolution and sensitivity, offering non-invasive, quantitative imaging ([eetimes.eu](https://www.eetimes.eu/swiss-quantum-sensing-startup-raises-e3-6m/?utm_source=openai)).

• **Integrated hardware and software solutions**  
  Qnami provides a complete platform—including diamond-based Quantilever probes, AFM integration, and data analytics software—designed for ease of use, automation, and flexibility ([eu.36kr.com](https://eu.36kr.com/en/p/3478991309838724?utm_source=openai)).

• **Strong academic and industry collaborations**  
  The company collaborates with leading universities and research institutions, and has formed strategic partnerships with industry players like HORIBA for global distribution and Quantum Design in East Asia ([instrumentbusinessoutlook.com](https://instrumentbusinessoutlook.com/press-release/horiba-signs-strategic-cooperation-agreement-qnami-accelerate-scanning-nv-magnetometry-developments-start-global-distribution-first-quantum-microscope-qnami-proteusq/?utm_source=openai)).

• **Broad applicability across research and industry**  
  Qnami’s technology is applied in diverse fields such as materials science, spintronics, 2D materials, magnetic memory, superconductivity, and semiconductor R&D ([qnami.ch](https://qnami.ch/applications/?utm_source=openai)).

• **Strong market traction and global reach**  
  The ProteusQ is already deployed in over ten research centers across Europe and North America, with expanding distribution networks in Asia through exclusive agreements ([thequantuminsider.com](https://thequantuminsider.com/2024/02/02/qnami-expands-into-japan-and-south-korea/?utm_source=openai)).

These strengths position Qnami as a leading innovator in quantum sensing, offering advanced, integrated solutions with growing global adoption.
